meta.name: intel-discipline-advisor
meta.description: Triage a competitive or market question into the right intelligence disciplines, cadence, and executing skill. Use when you know something needs researching but not which channel to run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分流市场疑问到正确的研究路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常面对研究问题却不确定该用哪个方法和技能。
copy.tagline_en: Route a competitive or market question to the right research path.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face research questions but aren't sure which skill to use.

howto.what: 当你有竞争或市场情报问题却不知从哪查起，它会先问三个问题，再给出几条编号建议，每条写清楚：查哪些信息源、多久查一次、用什么工具、产出什么。它还会解释选择理由，并判断是否需要真去调查，最后给你一张分诊卡。
howto.when: 当你有一个需要调研的竞争或市场问题，但不确定该走哪个情报渠道时触发。例如：怀疑对手在行动、想刷新TAM等分析材料、或想建立长期监控。

say.text: 我觉得对手在搞事，但不知道从哪查起。
say.note: 会先问情况、细节和限制，再给建议。

say.text: 我每季度只有4小时做竞争情报，怎么分配？
say.note: 会按时间容量推荐合适的监控节奏。

say.text: 我的TAM测算被质疑了，该用什么渠道重新算？
say.note: 会匹配TAM计算所需的学科组合。

howto.what_en: It asks 3 questions, then recommends which intelligence disciplines to run, at what cadence, by which skill, and what artifact it produces. It shows the reasoning, can say when no investigation is needed, and ends with a triage card.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to research a competitive or market question but are unsure which channel to run, such as suspecting a competitor move, refreshing an artifact, or setting up a watch.

say_en.text: I think a competitor is up to something but I don't know where to look first.
I have four hours this quarter for competitive intel — where do they go?
say_en.note: It will scale the cadence to your capacity.

say_en.text: My TAM estimate got challenged; which channel should I use to redo it?
say_en.note: It will match the discipline mix for TAM.
